label: ONNXim example multi-core NPU (4 systolic-WS cores, simple NoC)

provenance.normalisation: The upstream file repeats an identical block per core. This profile keeps one per_core block plus cores=4; the four upstream core blocks are byte-identical, so this is lossless.
provenance.verified_by: file read from vendor/ONNXim_git at the pinned commit

derived._comment: Sram.cc sizes each scratchpad as spad_size/2 (two halves for double buffering). Recorded because any capacity check must use the same number as the backend.
derived.note_on_backpressure: With icnt_type=simple the interconnect reports is_full()==false, i.e. NO backpressure. Backpressure only exists with the booksim2/ramulator2 backends.
